headline: Seznam.cz will connect Mapy.com with its own artificial intelligence by the end of the year | ČeskéNoviny.cz
summary: Seznam.cz plans to connect its Mapy.com service with its own artificial intelligence by the end of the year. It also aims to add AI to its Sauto and Kupi.cz sites, having begun rollout on Sreality.cz.
why: Seznam.cz is the largest domestic internet company in the Czech Republic, and its AI deployments indicate how local platforms are competing in digital services.
